title: Kaldereta Filipino Beef Stew
description: A classic Filipino beef stew recipe known for its rich and savory flavor.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, water, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours or until the beef is tender.
Add the potatoes and bell peppers to the pot and continue to simmer for another 30 minutes.
Stir in the Kaldereta mix and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
